description: Defines classes and templates for asynchronous event handling, including async_event_source and async_single_event_observer, with mechanisms for subscribing, setting results, and timeouts.

classes.name: async_event_source
classes.description: Publisher class for async events, allowing a single subscriber and supporting result setting and observer management.

classes.name: async_single_event_observer
classes.description: Awaitable observer for a single async event, supporting subscription, timeout, and result retrieval.

methods.name: has_subscriber
methods.description: Checks if a subscriber is registered.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Forwards a result to the subscriber if present.

methods.name: set_observer
methods.description: Associates an observer with the event source, optionally with a timeout.

methods.name: subscribe_to
methods.description: Subscribes the observer to an event source, with optional timeout.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Checks if the observer is connected to an event source.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Checks if the event result has been set.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Retrieves the event result, with const and rvalue overloads.

methods.name: get_awaiter
methods.description: Returns the awaiter for the event.
